# cycle_api_keys (Data Source)

Lists all Cycle hub API keys. The create-time `secret` is not exposed on this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every API key in the hub. Secrets are not included.
data "cycle_api_keys" "all" {}

output "api_key_names" {
  value = [for k in data.cycle_api_keys.all.api_keys : k.name]
}

output "live_api_key_ids" {
  value = [
    for k in data.cycle_api_keys.all.api_keys : k.id
    if k.state == "live"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_keys` (Attributes List) All API keys in the hub. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--api_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_keys`

Read-Only:

- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this API key belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the API key.
- `ips` (List of String) The allowlist of IP addresses that may use this API key. Empty means unrestricted.
- `name` (String) The user-defined name of the API key.
- `role_id` (String) The ID of the hub role this API key inherits permissions from.
- `state` (String) The current state of the API key.
